args.body: Hello, thanks for reporting your front door. Sorry, our system wrongly logged this as a fridge issue; I've corrected it to a door repair and treated it as urgent. Until it's fixed, please try not to slam the door, as glass could break. Mind any glass if the door is slammed. Two quick questions: 1) Does the front door close and lock securely when you leave or at night? 2) Is any glass cracked or damaged, on the front or back door? Please also tell us any times that suit for access. We'll update you on the next step by tomorrow. If you ever feel unsafe, call 999.
